Communications Act of 1934 / Telecommunications Act of 1996.
Title I: General provisions. FCC establishment and jurisdiction.
Title II: Common carriers. Local exchange carrier obligations. Interconnection requirements.
Title III: Radio. Spectrum allocation. Broadcasting licenses.
Title IV: Procedural and administrative provisions.
Title V: Penal provisions.
Title VI: Cable communications. Title VII: Miscellaneous.
1996 Act: Promotion of competition, deregulation, universal service.
